 Oelwein High School free FAFSA completion assistance night is Wednesday from 4-7 p.m. at Oelwein High School Library. Please bring a computer or iPad if available. For the appointment, students and parents will need required documents. See Oelwein High School Counselor's Corner on Facebook for details.
